cover letter
High school diploma or equivalent experience.
Four-year degree or equivalent combination of experience/training.
Related administrative/clerical experience sufficient to demonstrate ability to handle a high level of customer service while under pressure of time and deadline constraints.
Related experience including the ability to promote programs with varying curricula.
High level of computer skills with demonstrated experience using student information systems (or other relational database systems), Google Suite, MSOffice Suite, and other word processing.
Experience with systematically maintaining records and information in hard copy and archived formats.

Under general supervision of the Director, Student Success and International Programs, the incumbent provides excellent customer service to students, instructors and staff. Responsibilities include enrollment and records tasks, with emphasis varying as determined by the academic calendar. Functions include, but are not limited to: enrollment; processing of student records, working with various databases and document archives to process payments, create invoices for billing purposes, process transfers and refunds; create and maintain student files; process transcripts, grades and enrollment verifications. This position works collaboratively with Student Services team partners to ensure records integrity, and excellent customer service.
Selected candidate will be required to pass a pre-employment criminal history background check.
Selected candidate must pass the employment misconduct disclosure process.

The selected candidate will be required to work a hybrid work schedule and must be able to work successfully from a home/remote office and fulfill the requirements of the UCSC telecommuting agreement.
Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.

The University of California has implemented a Vaccination Policy covering all employees. Employees, including new hires, are required to comply with any applicable policies relating to the University of California vaccine program.

Per the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (CANRA), this position has been identified as a Mandated Reporter. The selected candidate will be required to report known or suspected child abuse or neglect as defined by CANRA and will be required to sign a Statement Acknowledging Requirement to Report Child Abuse prior to commencing employment. CANRA Penal Codes, and related definitions, requirements, and responsibilities may be obtained here.

Strong interpersonal skills including tact, diplomacy and flexibility to work effectively with students, staff, instructors, and the general department, with the ability to maintain composure in complex and stressful situations.
Ability to assist students of all ages on academic program options, including all student programs (International, Workforce, Pre-College, Healthcare Pathways, Concurrent Enrollment, etc.).
Ability to work long periods of time at a computer with or without accommodation.

Ability and willingness to provide excellent internal and external customer service with attention to promptness and a focus on solutions; commitment to treating other with fairness, dignity and respect.
Ability to occasionally work overtime with little or no advance notice.
Demonstrated organizational and problem-solving skills sufficient to and meet deadlines under the pressure of high volume and frequent interruptions.
Ability to maintain appearance and conduct suitable for working in a professional setting.
Ability to work occasional evenings and weekends; flexible schedule and restricted vacations during peak periods.
Ability to become familiar with and comply with specific and detailed safety procedures.
